title: TG 12 U 2637 vs Ramesh Rathod Mileage Deficit
trigger_reason: Low mileage on TG 12 U 2637 (3.13 km/l vs 4.10 fleet benchmark). Decouple driver vs vehicle mechanical efficiency.
verdict: Driver Ramesh delivered exceptional 4.25 km/l when rotated to TS 07 UE 1234. However, Master Driver Suresh Yadav only managed 3.45 km/l on TG 12 U 2637. Defect is 100% mechanical (Turbo Hose Leak & Air Filter Clogging), not driver driving style.
resolution_action: TG 12 U 2637 admitted to Hyderabad workshop for turbo pressure test and manifold gasket renewal. Ramesh exonerated from fuel penalty.

title: Vikram Singh High Maintenance & Fuel Burn Across Trucks
trigger_reason: Vikram reported frequent brake shoe wear and low mileage (3.08 km/l) on TG 12 U 2637 and MH 12 AB 1234.
verdict: When Rajesh Patil drove MH 12 AB 1234, mileage rose to 3.88 km/l and maintenance stayed at ₹0.52/km. But when Vikram Singh drove the pristine AP 29 TA 5678, mileage plummeted to 3.41 km/l with 18 harsh braking events and clutch slip.
resolution_action: Vikram Singh placed on Eco-Driving Retraining & Throttle Telematics Alert. Assigned lighter cargo routes until certification.

title: Ramesh Rathod Transmission Affinity Diagnosis (Tata vs Ashok Leyland)
trigger_reason: Investigate why Ramesh Rathod performs above average on Tata (4.18 km/l) and Eicher (4.35 km/l) but struggles on Ashok Leyland 9-speed manual.
verdict: Neither driver nor truck is broken. KA 01 AL 3344 delivers 4.08 km/l with Mahesh, while Ramesh delivers 4.22 km/l with Tata. Ramesh is unfamiliar with Leyland crawler gear shift points causing unnecessary RPM revving.
resolution_action: System permanent fleet rule: Ramesh Rathod mapped exclusively to Tata & Eicher fleet. Ashok Leyland assigned to Mahesh Sharma and Suresh Yadav.

title: Live Test: Suresh Yadav Validation on TS 08 UB 9012 vs TG 12 U 2637 Overhaul
trigger_reason: Post-maintenance verification of TG 12 U 2637 turbo overhaul alongside benchmark baseline check.
verdict: Test underway: Suresh Yadav completed Trip 1 on freshly overhauled TG 12 U 2637 recording preliminary 4.12 km/l (up from 3.13 km/l pre-repair). Trip 2 scheduled return from Bangalore tonight.
resolution_action: Awaiting final return trip fuel receipt and sensor dump.
